items.md: Governance [B.3 ] Aspect 3 out of 10 members of the Board of Commissioners 2 are women out of 12 members of the Board of Directors are women Near-term Net Zero Emissions (NZE) targets approved by the Science Based Targets initiative (SBTi). Published the Communication on Progress (COP) report for the United Nations Global Compact (UNGC) Ranked among the Top 3 Public Companies in Indonesia and recognized in the ASEAN Asset Class under the ASEAN Corporate Governance Scorecard (ACGS) Achieved Corporate Governance Perception Index score 95.31 Categorized as Most TrustedSocial Aspect [B.3] [F.28] [F.3 0] Financial inclusion Bank account ownership Use of products or services (including BPJS): 75.30% 91.60% 89.60% 89.10% 70.20% 72.60% 68.60% 73.10% 87.30% 86.60% 67.80% 84.80% Rural Urban Rural Urban • Based on research by BRI Research Institute (BRIRINS) in 2024 • BPJS (Social Health Insurance Administration Body) is a government agency authorized and established to administer the social health insurance program for the Indonesian population. Number of micro and Number of micro and ultra-micro Customer ultra-micro loan customers savings customers (including satisfaction rate (including Pegadaian and PNM): Pegadaian and PNM): 35.90 Million 176.00 Million 87.06% Customer complaint Employee Engagement Voluntary employee resolution rate Survey (index on a 4-point scale): turnover rate 99.81% 3.51 1.29% Social Return for Investment (SROI) Value [B.1.e] [B.3] [F.23] [F.25] Development of culinary tourism at Tomohon Market 11.32 Halal certification training in Banten 7.60 Empowerment of the Belvie Women’s Group 11.26 "Ini Sekolahku" program in Central Maluku 7.02 Homestay assistance in Mandalika 9.86 BRI Planting Program: Grow & Green in Muara Gembong 5.85 Business equipment support in Lampung and Ujung Labuan Bajo 8.07 Sewing machine assistance for the Maumere Women’s Group 4.31 *) The SROI value is the return (in Rupiah) generated from every 1 rupiah of funds invested through the CSR program. BRIʼs programs produce an impact above 1, meaning they have a positive impact on the beneficiaries.Environmental [B 2] . Aspect Energy utilization: 2,848,795,079 MJ a decrease compared to 2,919,627,648 MJ in 2023 [B.2.a] [F.6] [F.12] EMISSION 124,155 ton CO2e compared to 130,610 ton CO₂e (2023) EMISSION 346 ,353 ton CO2e compared to 355,742 ton CO2e (2023) Reduction in emissions from avoidable emissions: 1,096,551 kgCO e 2 compared to 872,713 kgCO₂e in 2023. [B.2.a] Waste reduction by 14.75% compared to 2023. The total waste recycled was 703,560 kg which is equivalent to avoiding 524,180 kg . of CO₂e emissions. BRI Menanam has distributed 1,138,333 tree seedlings spread throughout Indonesia with a carbon absorption potential of 985.45 Ton of CO2e. Environmental expenditures (TJSL environmental pillar): IDR 60,484 million [F.4] Green initiatives: Operated 796 eco-friendly vehicles through the Green Network Initiative framework by 2024. Solar panel installation: Solar panels installed at 143 work units as of 2024.
